_doc: Edit this file to tune a11y gating without touching test code.
tags              Axe rule tags to include (WCAG levels, best-practice, etc.).
disabledRules     Rule IDs completely skipped — no violation object is emitted.
Use for confirmed false positives (Radix useId, gradient tokens).
criticalRules     Rule IDs that ALWAYS fail the build, even if axe rates them
minor/moderate. Whitelist of 'must never regress' rules.
warningRules      Rule IDs that NEVER fail the build, even if axe rates them
serious/critical. They still appear in the report as advisory.
Use as a temporary escape hatch while remediating.
failImpacts       Default impact levels that fail the build for rules not in
Env override: AXE_STRICT=1 adds minor + moderate.
Precedence (highest first): disabledRules → warningRules → criticalRules → failImpacts.
